description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component in Swift, verifying session matching logic, prompting behavior based on security levels, and fallback decision logic.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that verifies behavior of ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly matches sessions when the active session string matches the request session.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Verifies that recent activity timestamp triggers prompt when session is inactive.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Checks that prompts are shown or suppressed based on the mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Ensures prompts are always shown when security ask is set to always.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Verifies prompts are only shown for allowlist security level with ask set to onMiss.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Confirms that no prompts are shown when ask is set to off for any security level.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Tests that allowlist patterns allow resolution and permission decision.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Ensures deny decision when allowlist pattern does not match resolved path.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Checks fallback decision is allow when prompt cannot be shown.
